properties.displayName: [Baseline] Resources may only be deployed to approved regions
properties.description: Denies resources deployed outside the approved region list. Region control is the foundation for data-residency compliance, predictable latency, and cost governance. Global resources and Azure AD B2C directories are exempt because they have no meaningful region.

metadata.description: The effect the policy applies when a resource targets an unapproved region.
Regions where resources may be deployed.
